name: com.nova.modeling
description: A light Blender-style modeler inside the editor (Window > Model Editor): Object / Edit mode, vertex / edge / face selection, G R S with axis lock and typed values, Extrude, Inset, Loop Cut, Bevel, Subdivide, Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Symmetrize, Merge, Fill, Bridge, Shade Smooth, Undo, vertex groups that follow edits, checkpoints. Reference images behind front / side views with a silhouette compare (IoU + per-height width hints + diff image). Character tools: live Mirror and Subdivision modifiers, proportional editing, anime hair clumps and cards, Smart UV, material colors, toon shading with outlines. Opens FBX / OBJ / glTF (quads kept) and exports FBX, OBJ and GLB. Every operation is also a CLI command (nova model <op>) with JSON results and multi-view PNG renders, so an AI agent can model step by step and look at its work.
